reason: Observability only (issue #55): three more turn-skeleton boundaries now carry spans, of the six the bundle names (admit -> comprehend -> prefill -> invoke -> deliver -> debrief). `agent.prefill` (nora/agent/prefill.py's build_prefill) names which context blocks were built, which were declared but empty, and the rendered size in characters. `engagement.deliver` (nora/engagement/stages/deliver.py's check_outcome) carries `nora.outcome` off `Deliverer.last_outcome`, so a deliberate silence (no_send_call/empty_reply/cooldown_held) and a platform send failure (send_failed) are no longer the same shape in the trace. `dream.pass` (nora/app/runtime.py's dream_loop) opens one root per tick's dispatch, so the per-adaptor `dream:<name>` spans nest as its children instead of each becoming its own unrelated trace. Store reads under nora/infra/** (the fourth dark area the issue named) are left uninstrumented -- 144 files is not a pattern that generalises in one pass -- and are tracked as a follow-up comment on #55 rather than closed silently. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
